ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering Law of the People's Republic of China (2024 Revision, effective Jan 1, 2025); Administrative Measures for Beneficial Owner Information of Legal Persons, Unincorporated Legal Entities and Special Purpose Vehicles (PBOC and SAMR Order No. 3, effective Nov 1, 2024); Company Law of the PRC (2023 Revision, effective Jul 1, 2024); Foreign Investment Law of the PRC (effective Jan 1, 2020).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation of Taiwan Investing Company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Department of Commerce, Ministry of Economic Affairs, Taiwan
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization only; Taiwan is not a member of the Hague Apostille Convention. Precise sequence: (1) obtain certified copy from Taiwan MOEA; (2) notarize at the Taiwan district court notary; (3) verify through the Straits Exchange Foundation (SEF); (4) verify again through the Association for Relations Across the Taiwan Straits (ARATS); (5) submit the ARATS-verified document and Chinese translation to the PRC registration authority. No apostille may be issued or attached.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing of the Taiwan Investing Company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Department of Commerce, Ministry of Economic Affairs, Taiwan
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization route only: certified MOEA standing certificate -> Taiwan district court notarization -> SEF verification -> ARATS verification -> PRC acceptance. Hague Apostille does not apply.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution and Power of Attorney Authorizing WFOE Incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Taiwan Investing Company Board of Directors
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization route only: board minutes and PoA executed in Taiwan, notarized before a Taiwan district court notary -> SEF verification -> ARATS verification -> PRC SAMR/bank acceptance after Chinese translation. Apostille path is unavailable.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association of the Taiwan Investing Company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Taiwan Investing Company (certified counterpart from MOEA or the company secretary)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization route only: certified copy -> Taiwan district court notarization -> SEF verification -> ARATS verification -> PRC notarial translation and acceptance. Not an Apostille Convention document.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter for the Taiwan Investing Company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Commercial bank in Taiwan maintaining the investor's account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization route only: bank officer signature and seal -> Taiwan district court notarization -> SEF verification -> ARATS verification -> PRC beneficiary bank or SAMR acceptance. Hague apostille must not be chained.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: UBO Declaration and 25% Ownership Structure Certificate
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Taiwan Investing Company signed by its legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization route only: signed declaration -> Taiwan district court notarization -> SEF verification -> ARATS verification -> PRC PBOC/SAMR Beneficial Owner Information filing. Apostille is not permitted.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory dual-layer screening of each beneficial owner, director, shareholder above 25%, legal representative, and authorized signatory against: (1) the UN Consolidated Sanctions List; (2) the US OFAC SDN, Non-SDN, and sectoral sanctions lists; (3) the PRC anti-terrorism and anti-money-laundering name lists; (4) SAMR and Ministry of State Security watchlists; (5) Taiwan MOEA and Financial Supervisory Commission restrictive measures; and (6) adverse-media and politically-exposed-person repositories. Domestic and foreign PEPs, including family members and close associates, require senior-management approval, source-of-wealth proof, enhanced due diligence, and post-incorporation transaction monitoring. Any sanctions or serious adverse-media hit triggers a Suspicious Transaction Report or a no-go escalation before filing.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: SAMR National Enterprise Registration Online Service Platform (National Enterprise Name Clearance and Reservation System)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The Chinese enterprise name must be formed in four tiers: (i) administrative division; (ii) distinctive trade name; (iii) industry term matching wholesale of ophthalmic eyewear frames; and (iv) the legal form 'Co., Ltd.'. Simplified Chinese characters are mandatory. A parallel English or romanized transliteration may be reserved only as a registered parallel name, and must not diverge materially from the Chinese name or infringe third-party trade marks. Pinyin transliteration is accepted for foreign investor names but cannot replace the statutory Chinese-name structure.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If SAMR or the local municipal market regulation authority rejects the proposed name, the applicant must request a written statement of rejection, then lodge an administrative appeal through the same National Enterprise Registration Online Service Platform within 15 days. The appeal must attach the original rejection notice, a legal argument distinguishing the prior conflicting name or explaining removal of a prohibited token, a corrected four-tier Chinese name, and any consent letters or approvals for sensitive tokens. If the original registry does not overturn the rejection within five working days, the applicant may file for administrative reconsideration with the next-higher SAMR body, and thereafter a judicial review with the people's court within six months. The same route applies to an expiring or unextended name reservation.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: For a China WFOE conducting wholesale international distribution of acetate eyewear frames, a pure virtual office or commercial-mailbox address is generally rejected by SAMR, the State Taxation Administration, and commercial banks. The registered office must be a physical, non-residential premises in China supported by a notarized or registered lease agreement, property ownership certificate, or landlord consent. The tax authority will require evidence that operations are actually conducted at the address and may restrict VAT invoice issuance where no personnel or business infrastructure is found. Banks mandate an on-site compliance visit and photographed office signage before account opening. Serviced or co-working offices are acceptable only if the contract includes a dedicated desk, meeting-room access, postal mailbox, and signage rights corresponding to the WFOE's legal name.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Checklist for an unannounced SAMR or municipal tax inspection: (1) nameplate matching the Chinese registered name visibly posted; (2) unexpired business-use lease; (3) personnel present during normal working hours; (4) books, contracts, invoices, and shipping records kept at the address; (5) the WFOE's registered telephone answered; (6) social-insurance and tax filings matching headcount and stated activity. Quantified risk: for a low-risk optical-frames wholesaler with no special license requirement, the annual probability of an unprompted on-site inspection is 5-12% in the first two years, rising to 25-40% if the address is residential, if the company applies for high-quota VAT invoices, or if the tax authority flags zero-occupancy or no-response indicators.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff: nil; no official incorporation or registration fee is charged under PRC Market Entity Registration Regulations.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark per source document; PRC notary official fee schedule.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China (2019, effective 1 January 2020), Articles 4 and 31; Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 Revision, effective 1 July 2024), Articles 42 through 60 and Article 47 on paid-in capital subscription; Regulations of the People's Republic of China on the Administration of Market Entity Registration (2022), Articles 4, 15 and 21.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR), delegated to the local Municipal Administration for Market Regulation (AMR), Enterprise Registration Division, with filings through the National Enterprise Registration Information System.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application Form for Establishment Registration of a Foreign-Invested Limited Liability Company together with the certified Articles of Association and the investor qualification package.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital applies to this wholesale ophthalmic eyewear frame WFOE. Under the 2023 Company Law, the sole shareholder must pay its full subscribed capital within five years from the issuance of the business license unless the Articles of Association or a more stringent sectoral rule imposes a shorter time limit. No blocked escrow account rule applies for this ISIC 4646 wholesale scope; the capital may be contributed in installments, but each remittance must be booked as foreign-invested paid-in capital through the bank and reported to the State Administration of Foreign Exchange.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION OF THE SOLE SHAREHOLDER AND FIRST BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF [OPTICAL FRAME WHOLESALE (SHANGHAI) CO., LTD.] (THE COMPANY), FORMALLY ADOPTED IN WRITING ON [DATE] BY UNANIMOUS CONSENT: 1. COMMENCEMENT. The Company is to be incorporated as a wholly foreign-owned limited liability company under the Company Law of the People's Republic of China and the Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China, with its principal office and registered address in Shanghai, China. 2. SHARE CAPITAL AND SUBSCRIPTION. The authorized registered capital of the Company shall be [US$50,000] or its RMB equivalent, fully subscribed by the Taiwan-resident sole shareholder, payable in cash in accordance with the Articles of Association and in no case later than five years from the issue of the business license; no escrow or blocked capital account is required for this wholesale business scope. 3. CONSTITUTIONAL DOCUMENTS. The draft Articles of Association and the company formation application, as presented, are ratified, and the directors and authorized signatories are directed to file such documents with the Administration for Market Regulation. 4. REGISTERED OFFICE. The registered address shall be [Shanghai address], leased by the Company and certified for domicile use; the management is authorized to execute the lease, to obtain the certificate of domicile, and to effect address registration. 5. STATUTORY OFFICERS. [Name] is appointed legal representative and executive director; [Name] is appointed supervisor; [Name] is appointed general manager. The legal representative and the general manager are each authorized to represent the Company in business, to execute contracts, to open and operate bank accounts, and to hire employees and agents within the approved scope. 6. BANKING AUTHORIZATION. The Company shall open a basic deposit account and a foreign currency capital account with [Bank]. The legal representative and the general manager, acting jointly or singly as the Bank may require, are authorized to execute account opening forms, signature cards, wire instructions, and foreign exchange conversion requests, all subject to SAFE regulations and AML/KYC policies. 7. TAX AND REGULATORY APPROVALS. The authorized officers are empowered to register the Company for tax, social insurance, VAT, invoice issuance, customs and foreign investment information reporting, to engage counsel and accountants, and to obtain any local licenses, certificates, or approvals necessary for the wholesale international distribution of ophthalmic eyewear frames. 8. INDEMNITY AND RATIFICATION. All acts previously taken toward incorporation are ratified, and the officers and authorized delegates shall be indemnified by the Company for good-faith conduct authorized by this resolution. This resolution is fully effective on the date adopted and shall continue in force until amended by a subsequent resolution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Pre-Registration with Market Supervision Administration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) / local Municipal Administration for Market Regulation (AMR) via National Enterprise Registration Information System online portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The proposed name and business scope are first screened by SAMR's national name database. Submit online through the provincial Government Service Network under the Enterprise Establishment module, selecting Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise (Limited Liability). The applicant must provide the investor's legal status and confirm the administrative district for the registered office. After retrieval, the applicant must lock the proposed Chinese name and reserve it for the follow-on establishment application. The reserved name may not be transferred and expires after one month. The system generates a pre-approval receipt that must be attached to the formal filing.
required_dossiers: Duly completed name pre-registration form
Investor's Taiwan-issued company registration certificate (notarized and cross-strait certified)
Board resolution of the Taiwan investor authorizing the establishment of a China WFOE
Copy of proposed legal representative's passport or Taiwan ID for applicant identification
Power of attorney if filing is made through a third-party agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If queried for similarity or prohibited characters, file a revised name application within seven working days through the same portal, cite the AMR name-review rectification notice, amend only the conflicting part, and preserve the original receipt number. If the system suspends the application for missing documents, upload the missing notarization certificate and request priority handling from the AMR service window.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization, Legalization and Cross-Strait Certification of Taiwan Investor Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Taiwan Notary Public Office / District Court Notary Office, the Strait Exchange Foundation (SEF), and in Mainland China the Association for Relations Across the Taiwan Straits (ARATS) through the local Notary Public Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Taiwan investor must have its corporate existence and capacity to invest evidenced by a company registration certificate and articles of incorporation notarized by a Taiwan notary public. Those notarial transcripts are forwarded to the Strait Exchange Foundation for authentication and then to a Mainland notary office through the ARATS channel for confirmation. A Chinese or English translation must accompany all traditional-script documents, signed by a certified translator. The sealed, certified package is valid for three months and must be lodged with the AMR with the registration application. If the investor structure involves trusts or multiple layers, extract the ultimate beneficial owner chart and source-of-funds declaration in the same notarization package.
required_dossiers: Taiwan company registration certificate
Articles of incorporation of Taiwan investor
Board resolution of Taiwan investor authorizing the investment and designated signatories
Notarial transcripts and SEF-ARATS verification letters
Certified English translation of all Traditional Chinese documents
Ultimate beneficial owner and source-of-funds declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If SEF-ARATS verification is delayed, follow up through the notary institution and request an interim authenticity certificate. If the AMR disputes the translation, obtain a sworn translator or a certified translation company reissuance and resubmit within five working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Negative List Clearance and Foreign Investment Information Reporting
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Development and Reform Commission (NDRC) and Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) jointly through the Foreign Investment Comprehensive Information System
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The wholesaling of ophthalmic eyeglass frames under ISIC 4646 and NAICS 423460 appears on neither the Negative List nor any restricted category, so the WFOE may proceed without a separate sectoral approval. Before filing, the legal representative must conduct a negative-list self-assessment and record it in the foreign investment information system. After obtaining the business license, the reporting entity must submit the initial report on foreign investment information, including the Taiwan investor, actual controller, corporate structure, and expected paid-in capital schedule, within 20 working days. Changes to paid-in capital, investor shareholding, or the legal representative must be updated through an amendment report in the same system.
required_dossiers: Negative List screening result or self-assessment statement
Business license (post-registration), if filed after incorporation
Articles of Association
Investor and beneficial owner disclosure forms
Foreign investment information report form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the reporting system flags the industry code as sensitive, submit the ISIC/NAICS mapping and the Negative List self-assessment letter to the local MOFCOM bureau. If there is a discrepancy between the broader business scope and the Negative List, revise the business scope by written shareholder resolution and file an amendment before continuing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Establishment Registration and Issuance of Business License
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Municipal Administration for Market Regulation (AMR), Enterprise Registration Division, National Enterprise Registration Online Service Platform
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The establishment application must be submitted with the lawfully certified investor documents from Step 2, the name reservation receipt, the signed Articles of Association, the domicile proof, and the appointment instruments. The AMR examines whether the registered capital is subscribed in accordance with Article 47 of the Company Law, whether the business scope is drafted in the prescribed classification format, and whether the legal representative, supervisor and manager have no statutory disqualifications. If accepted, the AMR completes review within three working days and online issues the unified-social-credit-code business license. The original paper copy, stamped by the AMR, is later delivered; the electronic license is immediately valid for banking and tax purposes. No administrative fee is charged.
required_dossiers: Company establishment registration application form (online, with automatic IDC verification)
Articles of Association signed by the Taiwan investor
Notarization and certification package from Step 2
Certificate of domicile, including lease contract and landlord property ownership proof or local government address approval letter
Identification documents of legal representative, supervisor, manager and contact person
Consent of each appointed statutory officer
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If AMR returns the application with a rectification notice, execute the corrections in the online system within 15 days. If the issue concerns the fitness of the legal representative, convene a written shareholder consent replacing the officers and re-upload the signed rectification form. If the application exceeds the SLA without decision, invoke the administrative service complaint and rectification mechanism through the municipal government affairs hotline.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Seal Carving, Bank Account Opening, Tax, Social Insurance and Foreign Exchange Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Public Security Bureau (PSB) licensed seal engraving units; commercial bank; State Taxation Administration (STA) local tax office; Municipal Human Resources and Social Security Bureau; State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) acting through the bank as single window
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Following issuance of the business license, the company must immediately engage a PSB-licensed seal engraving shop to manufacture and record the official company seal, financial seal, legal representative personal seal, and contract seal. The bank where the company opens the basic deposit account will verify the business license, uniform social credit code, seal inventory, board resolution naming signatories, and KYC/beneficial ownership forms. The opening of the capital account and conversion of foreign currency proceeds must be routed through the bank as the single window for SAFE; remittances must match the registered capital schedule. Tax, payroll, social insurance, and invoice registration are completed at the local tax and human resources one-stop service counters.
required_dossiers: Business license original and duplicate
Seal engraving permit application form submitted to PSB
Legal representative identification and power of attorney to open bank account
Bank account application forms and ultimate beneficial owner declaration
Tax registration supplement form, payroll list and social insurance enrollment form
Foreign exchange remittance documents, investment contract under SAFE, and capital account application
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests enhanced due diligence for the Taiwan investor due to cross-strait remittance, provide the SEF-ARATS certified investor identity file, a declaration of source of funds, and a corporate organ chart; the bank must respond within two weeks. If tax registration is delayed because of VAT classification, apply for provisional taxpayer status and correct the classification by the next filing period.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not Applicable for pure wholesale distribution under ISIC 4646; if the Company later adds physical manufacturing, chemical processing, assembly or warehousing covered by ISIC Groups 1xxx/2xxx/3xxx/4xxx or Division 52xx, the competent authorities become the local Industry and Information Technology Bureau, the Municipal Emergency Management Bureau, and the Municipal Ecology and Environment Bureau.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not Applicable - no separate industrial operating license is required for the wholesale international distribution of ophthalmic eyewear frames; the SAMR Business License with the wholesale business scope and the tax registration constitute the operating authorizations.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Ecology and Environment of the People's Republic of China (MEE) / local Municipal Ecology and Environment Bureau
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - no construction project or manufacturing activity is triggered; no EIA Report Book, Report Form or Registration Form is required for a pure office and wholesale operation under the MEE Classification List.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable for the exempt wholesale office activity. If the Company later adds frame edging, polishing, assembly or warehousing, the applicable mandatory thresholds include: wastewater discharge under GB 8978-1996 (pH 6-9, COD 100 mg/L, BOD5 30 mg/L, SS 70 mg/L, ammonia nitrogen 5 mg/L) before municipal connection; fugitive volatile organic compound control under GB 37822-2019 (non-methane total hydrocarbons monitoring point concentration 30 mg/m3) and organized emission limits under GB 16297-1996; hazardous waste such as acetone-saturated wipes, spent abrasives, plastic trimming waste and waste batteries must be identified, manifested and removed through a licensed hazardous waste transporter under the Solid Waste Law.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable for an office-only wholesale activity. If physical warehousing is established, the lessee must obtain from the Municipal Fire and Rescue Department a Fire Protection Acceptance Certificate, maintain a daily fire safety inspection record, comply with structural load and egress requirements under the Fire Protection Law, and complete workplace safety and occupational hazard registration with the Emergency Management Bureau covering electrical safety, anti-collapse, material stacking clearance, and general lighting and ventilation requirements.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) of the People's Republic of China; electronic portal: e-Tax (https://etax.chinatax.gov.cn)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise (WFOE) established in China, the entity automatically obtains a Unified Social Credit Code (USCC) upon registration with the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR). This USCC serves as the Tax Identification Number (TIN) for all tax purposes. The WFOE must complete tax registration with the local tax authority within 30 days of business registration, submitting the business license, articles of association, and legal representative identification. The tax authority issues a Tax Registration Certificate (now integrated into the USCC) and assigns a tax payer classification (general or small-scale). For foreign non-resident entities without a permanent establishment, a separate TIN may be required for withholding tax purposes, obtained via the non-resident tax registration process through the same e-Tax portal.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None (China does not offer check-the-box or hybrid mismatch elections; the WFOE is automatically treated as a resident enterprise subject to Corporate Income Tax on worldwide income, with no pass-through options)

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Annual taxable sales exceeding RMB 5,000,000 (for general taxpayer status); small-scale taxpayers may register voluntarily with lower thresholds, but mandatory registration applies at RMB 5,000,000
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: China mandates the use of the Golden Tax System (Phase III) for all VAT invoices. Invoices must be issued through the official e-invoicing platform, with real-time transmission to the STA's central database. The system requires API integration for automated invoice issuance and validation. Anti-fraud measures include digital stamping with a unique invoice code and QR code, and mandatory reconciliation of invoice data with VAT returns. Non-compliance results in fines and suspension of invoicing privileges.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exported goods (including ophthalmic eyewear frames) are eligible for VAT zero-rating under Article 15 of the VAT Law, provided the goods physically leave China and are sold to a foreign buyer. The exporter must be a registered general taxpayer and hold valid export contracts. Services and intangible assets are generally not zero-rated unless specifically listed.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Bill of Entry) - Form 1 (Customs Declaration for Export Goods)
Bill of Lading (or Airway Bill) evidencing shipment
Inward Remittance Certificate (FIRC) or Foreign Exchange Receipt Voucher from the bank
Sales Contract with the overseas buyer
Export VAT Refund Application Form (Form 2) submitted via the e-Tax portal
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The STA conducts rigorous audits of export refund claims. Any false declaration or failure to meet documentation requirements results in denial of the refund, recovery of previously refunded VAT, and a penalty of 50% to 500% of the tax evaded. Criminal liability may arise for fraudulent export refunds under Article 204 of the Criminal Law, with imprisonment up to 10 years. Additionally, the exporter's VAT registration may be revoked, and the entity blacklisted from future export refunds.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) of the People's Republic of China, operating under the People's Bank of China (PBOC)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The PRC maintains a managed dual-track foreign exchange regime under which the Renminbi is not freely convertible on the capital account. Current account items, including the wholesale export of ophthalmic eyewear frames, are broadly liberalised; onshore banks may settle receipts and payments on the basis of verified trade documents and the SAFE trade monitoring system. Capital account items, however, require a dedicated FDI foreign exchange registration, an onshore FDI capital settlement account for injection of equity, and strict supervisory follow-up after each use of funds. Export proceeds must be repatriated to China, after which the WFOE can either retain them in a current account settlement account or convert them into Renminbi; no mandatory surrender ratio applies. Profit remittance to the Taiwan parent is permitted after the WFOE has completed its annual statutory audit, settled corporate income tax and any at-source dividend withholding, and submitted board minutes, audited financial statements, tax payment proof and the FDI registration file to the remitting bank. The standard 10% dividend withholding can be reduced under the Cross-Strait Taxation Agreement if the Taiwan parent supplies a valid tax residency certificate. The regime is designed to block speculative cross-border arbitrage and offshore shell financing while supporting genuine trade and direct investment, subject to daily banking true-transaction scrutiny.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: China has abolished mandatory conversion ratios for export receipts. Exporters must repatriate foreign currency proceeds into China and, within the general trade-reporting benchmark of 180 days from export customs declaration, either retain the funds in a foreign exchange settlement account at an onshore bank or convert them to Renminbi at market rate. A 0% surrender ratio therefore applies; the obligation is repatriation, not conversion. The supervising bank matches export receipts with customs declaration data; overdue or unreturned proceeds require written explanation and can trigger SAFE administrative investigation.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Not viable. Foreign digital EMI banks and challenger neobanks are not licensed by PBOC or SAFE to open domestic Renminbi corporate accounts, execute SAFE registrations, provide RMB clearing accounts, or access CIPS membership for the WFOE. Using an unlicensed EMI for core treasury operations in mainland China is legally impermissible and would create Banking Law, foreign exchange control, and cash-flow integrity risks. The WFOE should run all cross-border and RMB clearing through licensed onshore commercial banks; fintech platforms can only be used as supplementary expense-management tools where the actual settlement still occurs at a licensed bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is mandatory. For a newly formed WFOE, the statutory legal representative and typically the Taiwan shareholder's authorized officer must attend the initial corporate account opening in person at the chosen bank branch with original passports, incorporation certificates, company regulations, and official chops. Remote or consular proxy account opening is not generally accepted in mainland China for FDI entities; the bank performs a face-to-face KYC interview, verifies identity documents, records the beneficial ownership declaration, and may arrange a second visit before activating high-limit transaction capabilities.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opacity of the Taiwan parent ownership chain through nominee shareholders or multi-tier holding structures that prevent identification of ultimate natural persons.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide a full organizational chart down to every natural-person ultimate beneficial owner, the Taiwan corporate registry extraction, constitutional documents, shareholder registry, board resolutions, audited financial statements of all holding entities, and a signed PRC AML beneficial owner declaration; commit to updating SAFE, PBOC, and bank records within 30 days of any ownership change.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source-of-wealth and source-of-funds ambiguity for the initial paid-in capital remittance from Taiwan.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide the Taiwan parent's six-month bank statements, latest audited accounts, the equity subscription agreement, a board resolution approving the capital injection, evidence of lawful earnings or prior fundraising, and a declaration of non-use of third-party fund pooling; the remittance must originate directly from the Taiwan parent's own named account at a licensed Taiwan bank via SWIFT.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade document mismatch between the declared optical frames wholesale activity and actual payment flows, including over-invoicing or under-invoicing risk.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide a complete trade dossier for each underlying shipment: purchase orders, sale contracts, proforma and commercial invoices, packing lists, bills of lading or air waybills, customs export declarations, transport insurance, inspection certificates, and third-party logistics records; explain any unit-price deviations with transfer pricing documentation prepared under PRC and OECD transfer pricing rules.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-strait regulatory and sanctions watchlist sensitivity where beneficial owners or transaction counterparts share names with restricted or politically exposed persons.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide proof of in-house export-control and restricted-party screening reports covering all counterparties, end users, and ultimate delivery locations; present a written end-use declaration confirming that acetate frames are non-controlled consumer goods; and evidence that neither the Taiwan parent nor the WFOE is owned or controlled by sanctioned individuals.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: From the Taiwan parent to the WFOE, the wire must be sent by SWIFT MT103 from the parent's account in Taiwan to the WFOE's SAFE-registered FDI Capital Settlement Account at the onshore Tier-1 bank. Before receipt, the WFOE must complete FDI foreign exchange registration with the bank, file any required FDI contract approval or negative-list declaration, and record the remittance purpose as Investment in WFOE registered capital. Upon funds arrival, the bank will match the remittance with the capital payment confirmation letter, require a certified Chinese public accountant to issue a capital verification report, and then allow the RMB settlement of the foreign exchange capital for permitted business expenses under the negative list; each settlement and use of funds must remain traceable and reported through SAFE's foreign exchange information system.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For trade settlements, the WFOE should clear using SWIFT MT103 for open-account payments, commercial letters of credit executed through the bank's trade finance desk for larger or first-time counterparties, and documentary collections such as D/P and D/A for low-to-medium risk transactions. RMB cross-border trade settlement should use the Cross-Border Interbank Payment System (CIPS) via an onshore licensed bank; foreign currency payments require underlying trade documents and matching under SAFE's trade verification framework. All disbursements must cite the relevant SAFE current-account and customs declaration reason codes, retain shipping and cargo evidence, and stay inside the bank's post-transaction anti-money-laundering monitoring program.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore Renminbi/foreign currency forward contracts executed with the settlement bank under SAFE's real-demand principle, limited to actual trade and investment exposures
Onshore plain-vanilla foreign exchange options for hedging currency risk arising from receivables and payables
Cross-currency interest rate swaps linked to underlying cross-border loans or trade finance obligations, subject to SAFE certification and not for speculative profit
Offshore CNH non-deliverable forwards are not permitted for the onshore WFOE; any NDF access would be confined to a non-resident treasury entity outside the PRC regulatory perimeter

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual General Meeting (AGM) and approval of audited financial statements, annual business report, and profit appropriation or loss absorption plan
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General meeting of shareholders; minutes and registration documents available for inspection by the Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA, Department of Commerce)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months after fiscal year-end; for calendar year-ends, no later than 30 June. MOEA may extend in special circumstances.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to convene in time exposes directors to per-case fines under Company Act (NT$10,000-NT$50,000 and continued fines for non-rectification); repeated failure may result in MOEA ordering dissolution and eventual deregistration or strike-off if statutory filings remain delinquent.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Profit-seeking enterprise income tax annual return with audited financial statements, where the statutory audit threshold is met
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Taxation Bureau or Regional Tax Administration, Ministry of Finance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 1 May through 31 May of the year following the taxable calendar year; non-calendar fiscal years are due within five months after fiscal year-end.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unfiled returns are subject to a delinquency surcharge of 1% of unpaid tax for each two-day period up to 10%, plus monthly late-payment interest at the postal savings floating rate; deliberate concealment triggers an additional 2x shortfall assessment or penalty; lien, distraint, and revocation of business registration may be enforced by the Tax Administration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual foreign-invested enterprise operation report for an approved WFOE, including mainland-China-invested enterprise status if applicable
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEAIC)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months after fiscal year-end; calendar-year entities must file no later than 30 June.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing or failure to update the foreign-investment approval registration may lead to suspension of investment approvals, non-recognition of future remittance applications, and administrative fines or withdrawal of the foreign investment permit; persistent default is considered by MOEA when deciding compulsory deregistration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Company information annual declaration of major shareholders, directors, supervisors, and managers under Company Act Article 22-1
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA) company information declaration platform
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 31 May for the preceding calendar year; changes in the declared information must be filed within 15 days of the change.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file or false filing attracts MOEA correction orders and fines of NT$50,000-NT$500,000 per violation, with continued per-day fines for non-compliance; long-term non-compliance is a ground for administrative dissolution based on company registration violation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Business tax (value-added tax) periodic returns and annual reconciliation for the wholesale distribution activity
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Taxation Bureau or Regional Tax Administration, Ministry of Finance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Bi-monthly VAT returns by the 15th day of the second month following each two-month period, totaling six returns per year; annual VAT reconciliation is embedded in the 31 May profit-seeking enterprise income tax return.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unpaid VAT is collected with an additional 15% penalty for false returns and a 1% administrative surcharge per two-day period up to 10%; failure to register or file may result in fines up to NT$300,000, business suspension, and distraint of assets.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Employer withholding tax annual statement and individual income tax reporting of wages for locally employed staff
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Taxation Bureau or Regional Tax Administration, Ministry of Finance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Monthly withholding remittances by the 10th of the following month; annual withholding statements by 31 January of the year following payment.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to withhold or remit may impose a penalty equal to 1-3 times the tax amount not withheld or remitted; false annual statements attract fines under Article 108 of the Income Tax Act; persistent default leads to enforcement seizure and business deregistration.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A non-public Taiwan WFOE must have annual financial statements audited and certified by a licensed Taiwanese CPA if its paid-in capital is NT$30,000,000 or more (approximately USD 900,000 at standard conversion) or if so ordered by MOEA. Public companies, banks, insurance enterprises, and large financial institutions must be audited under IFRS regardless of capital. The tax administration may also demand a CPA audit where annual revenue is substantial or accounting records are incomplete, but Taiwan Company Act uses a paid-in-capital balance-sheet test rather than turnover or headcount as the primary threshold.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as endorsed by the Financial Supervisory Commission (TIFRS) is mandatory for public or listed enterprises and financial institutions; non-public WFOEs may apply TIFRS, the IFRS for SMEs, or Taiwan Business Entity Accounting Act and ROC GAAP consistently, and must convert to tax-basis adjustments in the profit-seeking enterprise income tax return.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under Company Act Article 22-1, every non-public company must disclose its managers, directors, supervisors, and all shareholders holding 10% or more of shares or capital contributions through MOEA's online information platform. The annual confirmation must be made once each calendar year by 31 May; any transfer or change causing the 10% threshold to be crossed must be updated within 15 days. Taiwan does not use a 30-day transfer-reporting window for this purpose; the 15-day change report is the controlling legal deadline. This annual declaration serves as the beneficial-ownership confirmation for AML or FATF purposes.
